name: Runner Extras - Report SaveAs Stream
brief: Proves Report.SaveAs-to-stream executes the real BC dataset pipeline in-process (Xml dataset in scope; external rendering throws at the processor-factory fork).
description: M1 of the report-execution build: Report.SaveAs(id,'',ReportFormat::Xml,OutStream) must run BC's real RunReportInternalCoreAsync — real report metadata, data-item iteration against the in-memory table provider, dataset XML written back through the decorator chain into the caller's OutStream. The negative test proves the OOS boundary moved from a blanket SaveAsAsync throw to the ReportResultSetProcessorFactory fork: an RDLC-layout render request must throw reason report-rendering-external.
